verdict.rationale: Publishing an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a service that runs a public API platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows HMRC offers either. The probe found the developer hub's robots.txt disallows every crawler except Googlebot, which works against pointing an AI agent at its API docs. The 'agent' references on the Making Tax Digital pages mean human tax agents, not AI agents, so they are irrelevant here.
